description: This file is a JSON schema defining the SystemAudioPlayer API, including its methods, events, and data structures. It serves as an interface specification rather than executable code.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the system audio player with the specified ID. The `SystemAudioPlayer` plugin destroys the player object. Any playing audio is stopped and closed, and volume settings are restored.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Configures playback for a PCM audio source on the specified player, including optional PCM or websocket security parameters.

methods.name: getPlayerSessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the session ID from a given URL, which was returned during an open call.

methods.name: isspeaking
methods.description: Checks if playback is currently in progress on the specified player.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a new player instance with specified audio type, source type, and play mode; returns a unique player ID.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback on the specified player, supported only for HTTP and file sources.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of audio from the specified URL on the designated player.

methods.name: playbuffer
methods.description: Buffers data for playback on the specified player.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes playback on the specified player, supported for HTTP and file sources.

methods.name: setMixerLevels
methods.description: Sets volume levels for primary program audio and system audio on the specified player.

methods.name: setSmartVolControl
methods.description: Enables or disables smart volume control on the specified player, with parameters for ducking thresholds and times.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback on the specified player.
